question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.

 
 
• Sick: Physically or mentally; not well or healthy. (बीमार)
 
• Immune: Something that cannot catch or be affected by a particular disease or illness. ( प्रतिरक्षित)
 
• Medicinal: A substance or plant having healing properties. (औषधीय)
 
• Immunology: The study of the immune system. (प्रतिरक्षा प्रणाली का अध्ययन)
 
 
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "**medicinal**" is the most appropriate option.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: Tea has been utilised for therapeutic reasons in India.
